name: @speedora/conversation-intelligence
description: Stateless module (JSON-in/JSON-out): Speaker Intelligence Phase C (Conversation Dynamics) - a pure, synchronous composition (no LLM call, no new detector) over a clip's already-reconstructed SpeakerTurn[] into turn-taking metrics (turnDensity, backAndForthScore, responseLatency, overlapRatio, interactionIntensity) and a heuristic ConversationType classification. See docs/ai/speaker-intelligence.md. No DB/queue access at all; see root ARCHITECTURE.md. Consumed by apps/worker's render-graph conversationDynamics node.
